page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.s3 family, utilizing the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. This configuration does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage.

The instance provides dedicated CPU allocation, ensuring consistent compute performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core or burstable environments. Because it lacks bundled local storage and has a lower memory-to-CPU ratio of 1:2, it is structured as a compute-focused resource. This hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require dedicated processing power but do not demand large memory footprints or high-speed local NVMe drives.

Appropriate workloads for the ecs.s3.large include compute-oriented tasks such as lightweight web serving, batch processing, microservices, and CI/CD build nodes. It is also suitable as a distributed node in compute clusters where memory requirements are modest.
